image_description: A composite image showing a Rhodesian Ridgeback dog in two different views. The top half shows the head and shoulders of the dog in profile against a window background. The bottom half shows the rear flank and tail area of the same or a similar dog resting on a dark leather chair, with a plant visible in the background.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Head is fairly long and flat with moderate stop.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The profile view clearly shows a long, flat skull and a distinct but moderate stop between the forehead and muzzle, consistent with the breed standard.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Eyes are round, bright, and intelligent, color matching coat.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The visible eye is round and dark brown/amber, matching the wheaten/red coat color. It appears alert and bright.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Ears are set high, medium-sized, and carried close to head.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The ear is visible, folded down close to the cheek, medium-sized, and set relatively high on the skull.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Ridge of reversed hair growing forward along spine from shoulders to hips forming two symmetrical crowns.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The top image shows the shoulder area but the angle and lighting obscure the specific 'ridge' detail. The bottom image shows the rear/tail area. The critical mid-back section where the 'crowns' (whorls) are located is not clearly visible in either crop to verify the symmetrical crowns definitively.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Coat is short, dense, sleek, and glossy ranging from light wheaten to red wheaten.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The coat texture appears short and sleek with a natural sheen. The color is a consistent red-wheaten tone across both image sections.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Body is muscular and athletic with deep chest of large hound proportions.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The neck and shoulder musculature in the top image indicate a powerful, athletic build. The depth of the chest is implied by the shoulder structure.
The front leg visible in the top image appears straight and well-muscled. The rear leg in the bottom image is partially obscured but shows no obvious deformity.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Tail is thick at base, tapering, and carried in slight curve.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The tail is visible in the bottom image, resting on the chair. It appears thick at the base and tapers naturally. The curve is slight as it rests.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Gait is free and powerful with strong drive.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The dog is stationary in both images (standing/sitting and lying down). Gait cannot be evaluated from static poses.

The geometry of the chair back and the plant in the background of the lower image shows slight warping and inconsistent perspective lines, typical of AI generation or poor compositing.
